class_guess: Shift-overflow counter: base-4 digit blocks in a bouncer, plus a one-time reset that leaves walls
summary: Bouncer on 11111010 with 4-state digit blocks (base-4 carry); 1 reset at 3e7 left static walls; no halt to 2e10
mechanism: Tape: runs of P=11111010 split by 6-cell digit blocks D0-D3; the head sweeps from the right edge to the first D0/D1.
Each sweep steps every visited digit D0>D1>D2>D3>D0 (base-4 carry); D3>D0 moves one P across, so runs double leftward.
At 2.97e7 the carry hit the left end: an 8e6-step rebuild left static walls X=11; digits cross them unchanged (to 2e10).

rules.name: edge
rules.to: l' P^n B   |   l P^n B --> l' P^(n+1) A
rules.cases: every sweep; tail alternates A/B, edge +4 cells

rules.name: turn@D0
rules.to: l D1 P^a B  (from B: l D1 P^(a+1) A)
rules.cases: head turns at D0; l untouched

rules.name: turn@D1
rules.to: l D2 P^a B  (from B: l D2 P^(a+1) A)
rules.cases: head turns at D1; l untouched

rules.name: carry@D2
rules.cases: carry continues into l (l* = l after its own visit)

rules.name: carry@D3
rules.cases: c>=1; one P moves left across the digit

rules.name: wall pass
rules.cases: X=11 (phase +2 wall) is transparent to the carry

rules.name: D1 meets wall
rules.to: l* X P D0 P^(c-1) R'
rules.cases: empty run between D1 and X; carry continues

rules.name: full-sweep model (real orbit)
rules.from: E(T; n_i, b_i) at a right-edge D record
rules.to: next D record = rules above applied once
rules.cases: gen 1 at 1e7 (297 sweeps) + gen 2 at 1e9 (596); D-X adjacency sweeps excluded
